No push was needed since nothing changed.

learnings.insight: Local `main` branch pointer in this workspace was stale (33ec45f) relative to the real remote (origin/main at d5bb5e3, confirmed via `git ls-remote origin main`) at the time this stage started. Comparing the feature branch against a cached local `main`/`origin/main` ref without an explicit `git fetch` plus `git ls-remote` cross-check could have produced a false 'ahead by lots, diverged' read when the branch was in fact exactly at the merge-base with true origin/main.
learnings.action: Integrator: always cross-check `git rev-parse origin/main` against `git ls-remote origin main` after fetching, not just the local branch pointer, before concluding a branch is behind/ahead/diverged.
